training_weighting.voronoi_definition: w_i = |{j in selection pool : pi(j) = i}|, pi = nearest same-class representative in L2-normalised UNI space, rescaled to mean 1
training_weighting.rescaling_reason: sklearn does not renormalise the L2 penalty by sum(sample_weight); raw counts would confound weighting with effective C
training_weighting.within_class_assignment_reason: a label-blind pi lets pi(j) cross classes, and then |loss_i - loss_j| is not controlled by ||z_i - z_j||, so the Lipschitz step of the bound fails
training_weighting.rationale: the bound |R_D(theta) - R_{S,w}(theta)| <= L * D(S) requires w_i to carry assignment mass; equal-weight training does not test the object the theory motivates, so the weighted arm is the only line connecting theory to experiment
training_weighting.D_of_S_recorded_as: covering_distortion (weighted mean nearest-representative distance over the whole selection pool)
training_weighting.bound_check: secondary, non-gating: across arms, does larger covering_distortion predict a larger audit-vs-pool risk gap

primary_contrast.why_not_geometry_plus_pilot: task_features() consumes every pool label via errors[i, y_i] -= 1 while geometry_plus_pilot consumes none, so that difference confounds 'task geometry helps' with 'label access helps'. The within-class permutation control consumes exactly the same labels and destroys only the point-to-gradient correspondence.

tau.enforcement: run_linear_probe.py exits unless --tau matches PREREGISTERED_TAU; --unfreeze-tau stamps tau_frozen=false into run_metadata.json
tau.sensitivity_runs: permitted but must be reported separately and may never replace the frozen primary analysis

gpu_gate.statistic: delta[d][b] = BA(treatment) - BA(control); per-dataset effect = mean over blocks; dataset is the unit of replication
gpu_gate.why_dataset_is_the_unit: blocks within a dataset resample the same capped candidate pool, so they are not independent; the 3/5 replication requirement replaces a pooled p-value
gpu_gate.threshold_justification: the project's own measured screen MDE is 1.2-8.8pp for full training; the probe removes training noise, and 1-3pp is the effect size the whole line targets, so 1.0pp is the smallest honest bar

rules.GO: mean over datasets of the per-dataset effect >= +1.0pp AND at least 3 of 5 datasets individually >= +1.0pp
rules.NO_GO: mean over datasets < +0.5pp OR at least 3 of 5 datasets negative
rules.AMBIGUOUS: otherwise -- extend blocks 6 -> 12 (CPU only, no GPU spend) and re-apply this rule exactly once; a second AMBIGUOUS resolves to NO_GO

gpu_gate.on_GO: 120 GPU runs, target-classifier training, same frozen tau and same primary contrast
gpu_gate.on_NO_GO: no GPU spend; report the probe result as a negative and close the task-geometry branch

secondary_endpoints_non_gating: training_weighting main effect (voronoi - equal) within each arm

ece15 -- KNOWN DEGENERATE, measured before the run: at budget 50/class with C=1.0 on unit-norm UNI features the probe is severely underconfident (bloodmnist acc 0.920 vs mean confidence 0.431, so ece15 ~ 0.49 for every arm). That offset is L2 shrinkage on a small training set, not a property of the selection. Between-arm ece15 differences are swamped and must not be reported as calibration findings.
round1 method ordering as a sanity check against prior Table-1 results
preregistration.multiplicity: exactly one primary endpoint, one primary contrast, one weighting level. Everything listed as secondary is descriptive and may not be promoted to the headline after the fact.

oracle_upper_bound.purpose: the three real allocators may all sit inside noise, in which case the comparison teaches nothing. The oracle answers the prior question -- how much headroom does allocation have at all -- before asking which allocator is better.
oracle_upper_bound.definition: allocate_by_direct_marginal over region curves whose demand side IS the evaluation set (demand_source='evaluation')
oracle_upper_bound.status_in_reporting: upper bound only; never a competing method, never a deployable result
oracle_upper_bound.leakage_guard: allocate_by_direct_marginal raises unless allow_oracle=True when any curve has demand_source != 'calibration'
